task.title: To Replace a Standard or Alternate Clause

step.cmd: Open the agreement document and view its standard or alternate clauses.

The clause currently in use has an In Use label next to it. If you have selected a standard clause, you can view all alternate clauses associated with it. Similarly, if you have selected an alternate clause, you can view the standard clause and other alternate clauses associated with it. Click View More to read all the alternate clause details.

Click the Replace button adjacent to the clause name. The clause in use is crossed out and replaced with an alternate or standard clause. After replacing a clause, you can Check in the Agreement Document.
